text:
Elaine: Quick sync — finalizing microsession slot ownership + telemetry plan for the webinar next Weds. We have 4 x 10-min microsessions + 15-min panel. Need explicit owners, rehearsal times, and a simple telemetry spec per slot. Who can own which slot?

Sam: I can take Slot 1 (overview + cost vs latency benchmark highlights). Can own the one-pager and demo script.

Mohit: I'll take Slot 3 (Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs + routing policy). Want to include a small perf table.

Jess: I'll own Slot 2 (live demo: routing + model fallback). Rehearsal ok for me at 9:15 PT that morning.

Elaine: Awesome — that leaves Slot 4 (customer case study). @sam can you confirm if we can pull a short quote from Acme by Friday?

Sam: Yes, I'll ping CS and confirm by EOD Thu.

ops-bot: Poll posted for rehearsal times — https://tinyurl.com/rehearsal-poll (reminder set for 3 days before event).

Jess: Telemetry proposal — track these events per session: join, leave, demo_start, demo_error, cta_click. Primary keys: session_id, speaker_id, user_cohort. Suggested metrics: join_rate, median_watch_time, cta_conversion.

Mohit: +1. Small schema to embed in the ops doc:

```
{
  "event": "string",
  "session_id": "string",
  "speaker_id": "string",
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "user_id": "hashed",
  "cohort": "string",
  "meta": {"latency_ms": "number (optional)", "region": "string (optional)"}
}
```

Elaine: That looks good. Keep meta minimal — we only need latency_ms on demo_start and demo_error. For CTA we should capture target_url and utm_campaign.

Sam: For run-of-show, proposing this condensed snippet — will put full in the shared sheet:

```
09:45 - Hosts on mic / intro (5)
09:50 - Slot 1: Bench highlights (10) — Sam
10:00 - Slot 2: Live demo + fallback (10) — Jess
10:10 - Slot 3: Dedicated/private tradeoffs (10) — Mohit
10:20 - Slot 4: Customer case (10) — TBD
10:30 - Panel + Q&A (15)
10:45 - CTA + close (5)
```

Jess: Planning note — add a short failure recovery cue for the demo: fallback to pre-recorded clip + quick slide deck. I’ll upload clip to the drive.

Mohit: Can we also wire a quick check in the console to verify model variants are reachable before live demo? I can add a 3-step checklist in docs:
- Run health-check endpoint
- Validate KV cache warm
- Confirm fallback model artifact exists

Elaine: Love the checklist. Assign fallback owner for each slot in case the primary is offline:
- Slot1: fallback Sam
- Slot2: fallback Jess
- Slot3: fallback Mohit
- Slot4: fallback Elaine (I'll coordinate with the customer)

Sam: Note on telemetry/analytics — we should tag CTA clicks by embed type (deck download, trial, contact-sales) so marketing can slice acquisition.

Jess: Rehearsal plan: full run-through + tech check at 9:00 PT, speaker-only dry run at 8:15 PT. Ops-bot, please nudge speakers 48h and 2h prior.

ops-bot: Scheduled reminders: 48h before -> 1769717400, 2h before -> 1769874000. Messages queued.

Elaine: Perfect. Action items:
- Sam: confirm Acme quote by Fri EOD
- Jess: upload demo clip + confirm rehearsal availability
- Mohit: add health-check checklist to ops doc
- Elaine: confirm Slot4 customer speaker and post final run-of-show by Monday noon

Sam: Got it. I'll update the shared sheet and add telemetry fields to the sheet columns. Link: https://tinyurl.com/wb-runofshow-sheet

Elaine: Thanks team — this is enough to lock the invites. If no objections, I'll post the slate to the guest ops list and schedule rehearsals. :thumbsup:
